brief.audience: Reader curious about a personal fitness project / the person behind it
brief.job: Summarize nine years of self-tracked movement and the site that records it
brief.narrative: Numbers first, then the story of the movement and the project

content.title: Nine Years, Eight Thousand Kilometres
content.subtitle: A self-tracked record of running, walking, riding, and hiking — and the static site that keeps it honest.
argument: Since March 2017 I have logged every run, walk, ride, and hike I could measure. The result is a continuous paper trail of 8,252 km and 1,539 hours of movement — not a training plan, but a habit of paying attention.
evidence: Running: 509 sessions, 3,487 km, longest single run 29.1 km
Walking: 2,940 sessions, 4,015 km — the quiet backbone of the data
Riding & hiking: 24 rides (64.8 km longest), 20 hikes, plus 11 moto tracks
303 habit check-ins logged: plank 94, situps 137, push-ups 69
Vanilla JS + HTML/CSS on GitHub Pages; inspired by zhaohongxuan/workouts
content.next_step: Next: automate the COROS sync to a nightly cron so the page never falls a day behind.
